Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

We're writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed additional certification steps beyond what the vendor originally scoped, and completing that process has taken longer than the initial estimate allowed for. As a result, the delivery date has shifted by two weeks.

The new target delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing to work closely with the certification body to ensure the integration meets all required standards before it goes live, and we do not anticipate further delays at this stage. We will keep you updated at each milestone between now and then so there are no surprises as we approach the new date.

Does 14 April still work for your internal planning, or are there dependencies on your end we should factor in as we finalize the rollout schedule? Please let us know if you'd like to set up a call to walk through the revised plan in more detail.
